cells.value: Which AI apps survive, and what each one is connected to at the end of 2026-10-01. Mission (Alex, 2026-10-01; wording per decision W03): every AI app keeps only Composio, its own 1Password route and a named list of built-ins (browser, computer use and the like, which are not connectors). Rule: every kept app reaches every tool through Composio; its own local copies go. Counts come from the end-of-day read of the local configs plus the run-log. 'live connections' = switched on today. 'duplicates of Composio' = connections Composio already has working (goal: 0). 'only here' = things Composio can't hold: they control this Mac, are the AI's own built-ins, or have no Composio login yet.
